title: Media Release: ELECTRICITY TARIFF REVIEW UPDATE
text:
MEDIA RELEASE
ELECTRICITY TARIFF REVIEW UPDATE
1 MAY 2026
At a time when many households and businesses are already managing costs arising from the
geopolitical tensions, the Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission (FCCC) recognises that any
increase in utility expenses places additional pressure on everyday Fijians.
FCCC has deliberated on the implementation of the electricity tariff authorization, taking into account
the ongoing escalating geopolitical tensions and the global fuel price volatility resulting in the
application for fuel surcharge by Energy Fiji Limited (EFL), FCCC has made the decision to defer the
EFL electricity tariff until July 31, 2026.
This means that the current electricity tariff structure pursuant to the Authorization dated 01 October
2019 remains unchanged during this period.
This deferment follows ongoing consultations and the need for further assessment of the proposed
fuel surcharge submission by EFL, alongside broader economic considerations and the potential
impact on households, businesses, and the energy sector across Fiji.
This decision reflects FCCC’s unwavering commitment to protecting the interests of Fijian consumers
while ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in regulated pricing. As an independent
regulator, FCCC exercises its mandate, guided solely by evidence, due process, and the long-term
wellbeing of the Fijian people.
The FCCC considers this extension necessary to ensure a balanced and well-informed outcome.
FCCC will continue to keep the public informed and assures all Fijians that their voices remain central
to our decision-making processes.
About FCCC
The Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission (FCCC) is an independent statutory body
established under Section 7 of the FCCC Act 2010. FCCC promotes effective competition and
informed markets, encourages fair trading, and protects consumers and businesses from restrictive
practices and controls prices of regulated industries and other goods and services where required.
-Ends-
